<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Corridor''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー通路</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、各ターンに１回、フォース４を使用して転換されたホスの位置カードを一番上に戻すことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-Echo-Corridor-SWCA-100685.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Corridor.

'''Light Side:'''
If you control this site, once per turn you may use 4 Force to return a converted Hoth location card to the top.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 位置カード where English says site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Corridor]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
